cond.lumbar_spinal_stenosis.etiology_zh: 腰椎椎管狹窄最常由老化相關退化改變逐步形成：椎間盤脫水、塌陷或膨出，椎間關節增生與骨贅，以及黃韌帶等韌帶增厚或皺褶，可共同縮小中央椎管、側隱窩或椎間孔。先天性椎管較窄者可較早出現問題；脊椎滑脫、創傷或骨折、發炎性關節病、腫瘤及 Paget 骨病等亦可造成或加重狹窄，但較少見。影像上的狹窄不一定產生症狀，須與臨床神經性跛行或神經受壓表現對照。
cond.lumbar_spinal_stenosis.etiology_en: Lumbar spinal stenosis most often develops gradually from age-related degeneration: disc desiccation, height loss or bulging, facet-joint enlargement and osteophytes, and thickening or buckling of ligaments can together narrow the central canal, lateral recesses, or foramina. A congenitally small canal can cause earlier disease; spondylolisthesis, trauma or fracture, inflammatory arthritis, tumors, and Paget disease can also cause or worsen narrowing but are less common. Imaging stenosis is not necessarily symptomatic and must be correlated with neurogenic claudication or other signs of neural compression.

etiology_zh: NIAMS: Spinal Stenosis — causes (last reviewed 2023-11); South Tees Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust: Ten Lumbar Spinal Stenosis Facts — cause and imaging-symptom distinction (retrieved 2026-08)
etiology_en: NIAMS: Spinal Stenosis — causes (last reviewed 2023-11); South Tees Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust: Ten Lumbar Spinal Stenosis Facts — cause and imaging-symptom distinction (retrieved 2026-08)

cond.stress_fracture.etiology_zh: 應力性骨損傷發生於反覆負荷造成的微損傷速度超過骨重塑與修復能力時；早期可先出現骨應力反應，持續承重後才形成可辨識的裂隙。機轉可分為兩類：正常骨承受異常、快速增加或重複的負荷（疲勞性骨折），以及骨質已因骨質疏鬆或其他疾病而減弱，在一般生理負荷下發生骨折（不全性／脆弱性骨折）。因此它不是一次急性撞擊所造成的典型骨折，且不能把所有病例只歸因於運動過度。
cond.stress_fracture.etiology_en: A bone stress injury develops when repetitive loading produces microdamage faster than bone remodeling can repair it; an early stress reaction may precede a visible fracture line if loading continues. Mechanistically, it may be a fatigue fracture, in which normal bone is exposed to abnormal, rapidly increased, or repetitive load, or an insufficiency fracture, in which bone weakened by osteoporosis or another disorder fails under ordinary physiologic load. It is therefore distinct from a typical single-impact fracture, and not every case should be attributed to athletic overuse alone.

etiology_zh: AAOS OrthoInfo: Stress Fractures — bone turnover, stress reaction, repetitive overload, and weakened-bone mechanisms (retrieved 2026-08); Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS: Caring for a stress fracture — overuse, rapid activity increase, and osteoporosis (retrieved 2026-08)
etiology_en: AAOS OrthoInfo: Stress Fractures — bone turnover, stress reaction, repetitive overload, and weakened-bone mechanisms (retrieved 2026-08); Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS: Caring for a stress fracture — overuse, rapid activity increase, and osteoporosis (retrieved 2026-08)

cond.spondylolisthesis.etiology_zh: 脊椎滑脫是椎體相對鄰近椎體移位的結果，並非單一病因。青少年常見峽部型：椎弓峽部反覆伸展負荷形成應力性缺損或骨折，失去後方穩定後可向前滑移；成人常見退化型，椎間盤與椎間關節隨年齡退化而失去節段穩定。其他較少見原因包括先天椎弓或薦椎上端發育異常、急性骨折、破壞骨質的疾病，以及手術後節段不穩。病因判讀應依年齡、滑脫位置、影像形態與是否存在 pars 缺損區分。
cond.spondylolisthesis.etiology_en: Spondylolisthesis is displacement of one vertebra relative to another and has no single cause. In adolescents, the common isthmic form follows repetitive extension loading that produces a pars interarticularis stress defect or fracture and permits forward slip. In adults, the common degenerative form results from age-related disc and facet-joint degeneration with loss of segmental stability. Less common causes include congenital dysplasia of the posterior elements or upper sacrum, acute fracture, bone-destructive disease, and postoperative instability. Etiology should be classified by age, level, imaging morphology, and the presence or absence of a pars defect.

etiology_zh: AAOS OrthoInfo: Spondylolysis and Spondylolisthesis — pars stress fracture, repetitive extension, and slippage (retrieved 2026-08); NHS: Spondylolisthesis — age-related, familial, and stress-fracture causes (last reviewed 2026-03-17)
etiology_en: AAOS OrthoInfo: Spondylolysis and Spondylolisthesis — pars stress fracture, repetitive extension, and slippage (retrieved 2026-08); NHS: Spondylolisthesis — age-related, familial, and stress-fracture causes (last reviewed 2026-03-17)

cond.spondylolysis.etiology_zh: 椎弓解離多在兒童或青少年生長期，由腰椎反覆伸展、旋轉與著地負荷使椎弓峽部累積微損傷；當骨形成與修復跟不上負荷時，可由應力反應進展為單側或雙側 pars 裂隙。體操、足球、舉重及其他頻繁腰椎過伸的活動是常見促發情境，但部分人沒有明確運動史；先天或遺傳相關的峽部骨形態較薄可能增加易感性。急性單次外傷可致 pars 骨折，但不是典型機轉。
cond.spondylolysis.etiology_en: Spondylolysis usually begins during growth when repeated lumbar extension, rotation, and landing loads accumulate microdamage in the pars interarticularis. If bone formation and repair cannot keep pace, a stress reaction can progress to a unilateral or bilateral pars fracture. Gymnastics, football, weightlifting, and other activities involving frequent lumbar hyperextension are common precipitating settings, although some people have no clear sports history; a congenitally or genetically thinner pars may increase susceptibility. A single acute injury can fracture the pars but is not the typical mechanism.
